neighbours.label: taking something in for oneself: eating, gobbling up, snapping up, uptake, takeover (the - pole is giving something up: gave up, sold, surrendered)
fire: The hungry kids managed to eat every slice of the pizza.
A larger rival quickly snapped up the struggling startup.
Seagulls swooped down to gobble up the leftover chips.
The roots improve water uptake during dry summers.
Collectors rushed to buy up every copy of the first edition.
The python can swallow an antelope whole.
Investors feared a hostile takeover by the foreign group.
A crow landed and tried to snatch up my sandwich.
quiet: The hungry kids managed to share every slice of the pizza.
A larger rival quickly sold off the struggling startup.
Seagulls swooped down to look at the leftover chips.
The roots lose water during dry summers.
Collectors rushed to give away every copy of the first edition.
The python can spit out an antelope whole.

A crow landed and tried to drop my sandwich.
